fail_or_stop_conditions: Coverage ambiguity that can alter Memory/V2 event reconstruction.
Native terminal boundary required for analysis but unavailable under current authorization.
objective: Reconcile every canonical lifecycle identity to eligibility, coverage and causal event reconstructability without silently redefining the previously measured cohort.
pass_criteria: Every canonical identity is accounted for exactly once.
Every primary exclusion has evidence and every secondary reason remains visible.
Original eligibility and audited eligibility are separate fields.
Previous 33 can be reproduced or every discrepancy is exactly explained.
Coverage relevant to Memory/V2 reconstruction is explicit.
Lifecycle terminal ordering that affects the denominator is either resolved or explicitly blocks certification.

rules: All applicable secondary reasons remain additional_reason_flags.
IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED may not be hidden inside OTHER.
Missing bars are never imputed as flat bars.
A missing bar that can alter prior structural high invalidates downstream exact reconstruction until resolved.
NO_MEMORY is not an exclusion reason.

causal_event_ledger.grain: one row per required causal event

lifecycle_audit.grain: one row per canonical lifecycle identity

requirements: List the exact identities comprising every aggregate count.
Explain every identity excluded from the previous 33.
Attempt to reproduce the previous 33 under the same definition.
If audited classification differs, report the exact identity and reason; do not force prior counts.

terminal_time_authority_rule: Phase A may record native terminal time only from an already-authorized causal runtime event or a separately authorized diagnostic source. It must not read prohibited outcome exit_time from the canonical trade outcome surface merely for convenience.
